title: Insurance Coverage & Claims: Amount in Dispute on an Internal Appeal to a Contracted Commercial Plan
content:
The amount in dispute that Halverson Clinical Laboratories records when it files a first-level internal appeal on a claim of a contracted commercial plan held under **Insurance Coverage & Claims** is defined as follows.

## Definition

**(a) The claim.** The internal appeal's claim is the claim carrying the most recent medical-necessity denial (CO-50) on the coverage.

**(b) Disputed charges.** The internal appeal's disputed charges are the claim's medical-necessity (CO-50), frequency (CO-151) and authorization (CO-197) denial amounts, plus its missing-information (CO-16) and patient-identification (CO-31) denial amounts while no corrected claim stands on that claim. The internal appeal's disputed charges are fixed only after the claim carries a corrected claim answering each of its missing-information denials.

**(c) Valued charges.** The disputed charges taken at billed value.

**(d) Member portion.** The valued charges times a member share of 15 percent, divided by one hundred; the member portion stands as figured.

**(e) Plan portion.** The valued charges less the member portion.

**(f) Interest.** The plan portion times the annual interest rate, divided by one hundred, times the interest days, divided by 365. The annual interest rate is 8 percent, and no interest days run, so the interest is zero.

**(g) Underpayment addition.** Nothing is added.

**(h) Amount in dispute.** The plan portion plus the interest plus the underpayment addition, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, with no rounding before the final cent.

## The same definition as a sequence of quantities

| Quantity | Built from |
|---|---|
| Disputed charges | CO-50, CO-151 and CO-197 amounts on the claim (and CO-16 and CO-31 amounts while no corrected claim stands on the claim) |
| Valued charges | Disputed charges at billed value |
| Member portion | 15 percent of the valued charges |
| Plan portion | Valued charges less member portion |
| Amount in dispute | Plan portion plus interest plus underpayment addition, rounded once |

## Worked figure (hypothetical claim)

A claim carries a CO-50 denial of 310.00 USD, a CO-197 denial of 95.50 USD and a CO-16 denial of 40.00 USD, and a corrected claim answering the CO-16 denial stands on it.

- Disputed charges: 310.00 plus 95.50, that is 405.50 (the CO-16 amount is not included, a corrected claim standing on the claim).
- Valued charges: 405.50.
- Member portion: 405.50 times 15, divided by one hundred, that is 60.825.
- Plan portion: 405.50 less 60.825, that is 344.675.
- Amount in dispute: 344.675 plus 0 plus 0, rounded half up once, **344.68 USD**.
